question: Will the UN Security Council hold a fourth Secretary-General straw poll between October 1 and October 3, 2026?

calls.reasoning: As of 2026-09-22 no fourth straw poll is scheduled or announced (1for8billion log and SCR SG page show only 30 Jul / 21 Aug / 18 Sep; PassBlue 18 Sep: 'no date has been set'). The window Oct 1-3 is Thu-Fri-Sat, i.e. two business days, and the first two days of Greece's presidency when the monthly programme is being set rather than executed. This cycle's observed inter-poll gaps are 22 and 28 days, implying ~9-16 October; landing in the window requires a compressed 13-15 day gap. Pulling toward YES: SCR/PassBlue note a fourth poll 'could follow shortly after High-Level Week' (ends 28 Sep), late-stage polls in 2016 (5 Oct colour-coded) and 2006 (2 Oct, the fourth poll) clustered in early October, and the Council is behind 2016's pace with a 31 Dec deadline. Pulling toward NO: reporting of possible late-entrant/compromise candidates argues for giving newcomers time, post-HLW wrap-up consumes 29-30 Sep, and colour-coded format needs P5 agreement. Rough date distribution: <1 Oct 4%, 1-3 Oct ~14%, 5-9 Oct ~28%, 12-16 Oct ~20%, later Oct ~18%, Nov+ ~12%, never ~4%. No human market prices poll timing; Polymarket's SG-winner market is a different contract and not an anchor.
calls.reference_class: UNSC Secretary-General straw polls in the 2016/2006/2026 processes, and specifically the timing of the next unscheduled poll relative to a named 2-3 day window ~10 days out
